integrity: The complete four-page 1980 foundational article was inspected and fixes the public date 31 March 1980 while developing perturbative limit-cycle bifurcation rather than invariant-measure conditional moments. A full author-posted global-dynamics article on the exact equations was inspected and searched for moment, average, and invariant-measure formulations. The complete open 2018 preprint was inspected, including the exact system, Lorenz-attractor parameters, and mathematical classification; targeted full-document searches found no matching invariant-measure, conditional, covariance, or average theorem. A same-object integrability paper was compared at stated-theorem level. The conditional laws, variance and covariance defects, y-moment identity, equilibrium-supported equality case, height barrier, and bounded-complete memory formula were independently reconstructed and replayed with the packaged checker.
scientific_limitations: The theorem assumes a compactly supported invariant probability measure; the pointwise memory identity assumes a bounded complete trajectory.
The conditional calibration determines only the first conditional moment of squared amplitude, not the full conditional distribution.
The recurrence barrier proves positive stationary mass above z=1 but not positive mass below z=1.
The result does not address entropy, Lyapunov exponents, Lorenz-attractor parameter boundaries, or unbounded solutions.
A differently phrased equivalent generator identity could remain in unindexed literature.
title: Fiberwise amplitude calibration and an outer-height recurrence barrier in the Shimizu–Morioka flow
